messages:
Maria Chen: Invoice INV-2026-009 shows our dedicated commit split across two node pools (pool-west & pool-eu). There's also a cross-charge line to 'atlas-ux' acct that shouldn't be there. Can someone confirm allocation tags? cc @Devon
Devon Patel: Looking now. Did this start after the autoscale change on 3/10? @Samir do you have the commit ids for those pools?
billing-bot: Thanks for reporting. I've created billing ticket #BILL-4892 and attached invoice files. Support will follow up in 1 biz day.
Samir Rao: We did flip `nodepool.autoscale.preemptible=false` on 2026-03-10 which moved some workloads. Commit IDs: commit-ded-42 and commit-ded-43. Both tagged with `customer:helio-maps` in our deployment config.
Maria Chen: Invoice lines (excerpt):
```csv
line_id,account,commit_id,pool,amount_usd,tags
L001,helio-maps,commit-ded-42,pool-west,3125.00,customer:helio-maps;env:prod
L002,atlas-ux,commit-ded-43,pool-eu,2980.00,customer:atlas-ux;env:prod
L003,helio-maps,commit-ded-42,pool-west,120.00,burst:overage
```
The atlas-ux line is suspicious — we didn't run anything for them.
Kira Billing: Thanks. I see commit-ded-43 is alphabetically mapped to atlas-ux in our billing ORC table — likely a tag sync failure. Please send the top of the deployment manifest (first 50 lines) for commit-ded-43 and a screenshot of the commit tags. Also confirm whether helio-maps paid for dedicated burst on Mar 10-12.
Devon Patel: Tag sync: `billing.sync` job had a transient failure 2026-03-11 01:12 UTC (see logs). Samir can you paste the tag header from the manifest?
Samir Rao: Manifest header:
```yaml
name: helio-maps-ingress
labels:
  customer: helio-maps
  team: maps
annotations:
  billing-commit: commit-ded-43
```
Maria Chen: We didn't authorize atlas-ux to be billed. Kira, if this is a tag sync bug can we revert that line and issue SLA credit if needed? We need an estimate of customer exposure.
Kira Billing: If it's our sync bug, we'll reverse the line and issue provisional credit. Need to confirm actual usage. @billing-bot please attach usage window 2026-03-10 -> 2026-03-12 for commit-ded-43 and show per-customer breakdown.
billing-bot: Attached usage report: https://redwood.internal/billing/reports/BILL-4892/usage.csv
Summary: 85% of tokens/compute attributed to helio-maps for commit-ded-43; 15% to atlas-ux. Opening an internal investigation.
Devon Patel: :thumbsup: If 85% belongs to helio-maps we'll pro-rate and issue a corrected invoice + SLA credit for the small misbilled portion. Kira please add the credit reason code `SYNC_TAG_MISATTR`.
Kira Billing: Added reason code. I'll draft the corrected invoice and provisional SLA credit (up to $450) pending final reconciliation. Will update ticket BILL-4892 with timelines.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Please loop in sales if we need to notify helio-maps customer contact. @Devon can you take that if it becomes customer-facing?
Devon Patel: Yep, I'll own customer comms if needed. I'll wait for the final usage CSV.
billing-bot: BILL-4892 status: investigation complete. Corrected invoice issued INV-2026-009-R1, SLA credit $375 applied. Customer notified.
